ReturnPassword.title: Return password
ReturnPassword.description: Set up the Return module password

ReturnNewNumberTemplate.title: Return number template
ReturnNewNumberTemplate.description: Use this template to generate new order returns

WindowDays.title: Return window, days
WindowDays.description: How long after delivery a line stays returnable. Counted per line from the latest delivery date.

AllowedOrderStatuses.title: Order statuses allowing returns
AllowedOrderStatuses.description: Comma-separated order statuses a return may be requested from. Blank allows nothing.

AllowedShipmentStatuses.title: Shipment statuses counted as delivered
AllowedShipmentStatuses.description: Comma-separated shipment statuses to count as delivered. Blank counts any status, and delivery is taken from the shipment delivery date.

Reasons.title: Return reasons
Reasons.description: Reasons the buyer picks per line. Localizable.

ReasonsRequiringComment.title: Reasons requiring a comment
ReasonsRequiringComment.description: Comma-separated reason codes that oblige the buyer to explain.

AttachmentsRequired.title: Photos or documents required
AttachmentsRequired.description: Require at least one file on every returned line.

SendNotifications.title: Return email notifications
SendNotifications.description: Email the buyer when a return is registered, approved, partly approved or declined.

SendPushNotifications.title: Return push notifications
SendPushNotifications.description: Also send an in-app push message on the same events. Requires the Push Messages module.

NotifyOrganizationEmail.title: Copy return emails to the organization
NotifyOrganizationEmail.description: Also send every return email the buyer gets to the email address of the buyer's organization.

Return.Reasons.title: Return reasons
Return.Reasons.description: Reasons the buyer picks per line

ReturnRegisteredEmailNotification.description: The buyer gets an email when their return request is registered and waiting to be reviewed

ReturnApprovedEmailNotification.description: The buyer gets an email when every line of their return is approved in full

ReturnPartiallyApprovedEmailNotification.description: The buyer gets an email when some of the requested quantities are approved and some are not

ReturnRejectedEmailNotification.description: The buyer gets an email when none of the requested quantities are approved

ReturnCancelledEmailNotification.description: The buyer gets an email when their return request is cancelled and no longer waiting to be reviewed
